run_inference_on_dataset: run a model on a data loader and evaluate metrics with a DatasetEvaluator
create_DatasetEvaluator_subclass: create a custom DatasetEvaluator subclass that implements reset, process, and evaluate methods
combine_DatasetEvaluators: combine multiple DatasetEvaluator instances into a single DatasetEvaluators wrapper to dispatch evaluation calls
use_inference_context: use the inference_context manager to temporarily set a torch model to eval mode
benchmark_inference_speed: benchmark model inference speed on a dataset by running inference_on_dataset with no evaluator
